title: Banjo: Recompiled 3D
description: 3DS Port of Banjo-Kazooie made using rt64-3ds
long_description:
* Real stereoscopic 3D, with auto convergence that keeps close-ups comfortable
* Widescreen 400x240 on the top screen
* 60 fps most of the time on a New 3DS, with interpolated frames between the game's own (in play and in cutscenes)
* The HUD on the touch screen
* Camera control on the C-Stick
* Settings on the touch screen, opened with SELECT: remap any button, add up to two buttons of your own on the touch screen
* Built-in community mods you can turn on and off: Ability Anywhere, Transform Anywhere, Banjo Bee, Cheats, Skip It, Toggle Trot, Exit To Lair and more, with touch screen buttons where they need them
* Spanish, French, and German translations
* Three ROM hacks playable as game modes: BK The Jiggies of Time, BK Nostalgia 64 and Banjo Dreamie
* Runs on an Old 3DS / 2DS too, at 20-30 fps
preinstall_message: You must provide your own dump of the US v1.0 of the game at: sdmc:/3ds/BanjoRecomp/BK.z64
